misprints.note: Kryddande: printed with upsilon and rough breathing instead of eta.
Participle ending printed without accent (ἰσχύων, ουσα, ον).
Krympling: printed with no breathing or accent at all.
ἰσχύς, ύος: genitive ending printed without breathing, the normal style for endings, so this is not an error. Listed only because the OCR had ὑός.

uncertain.note: The period after 2 falls on the cropped right edge of the strip. Supplied because the book's usage is regular.
The accent on ι (also in 0231_02, ἐντείνεσθαι (εἴς τι)) has an unusual shape: smooth breathing plus a stroke that could be read as acute, grave or circumflex. Transcribed as εἴς.
The mark after κορωνόπους looks like a period but could be a weak comma.
